chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar al-Yamani and Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Aban, from Sulaym ibn Qays, who said:

I witnessed the bequest of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام when he bequeathed to his son al-Hasan عليه السلام, and he made al-Husayn عليه السلام, and Muhammad, and all of his children, and the chiefs of his Shi'ah, and the people of his household witnesses over his bequest.

Then he handed over to him the Book and the weapon, and said to his son al-Hasan عليه السلام: 'O my son, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله instructed me to bequeath to you, and to hand over to you my books and my weapon, just as the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله bequeathed to me and handed over to me his books and his weapon; and he instructed me to command you that, when death comes to you, you should hand them over to your brother al-Husayn عليه السلام.'

Then he turned to his son al-Husayn عليه السلام and said: 'And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله instructed you to hand them over to this son of yours'—then he took the hand of Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. Then he said to Ali ibn al-Husayn: 'And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله instructed you to hand them over to your son Muhammad ibn Ali, and convey to him greetings from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and from me.'

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.السِّلَاحَ: the weapon transmitted as part of the Imamate trust
key_terms.الْكِتَابَ: the Book or written corpus handed down as part of the trust
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the succession from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام to the later Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the formal transfer of the sacred trust, including the books and weapon, from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام to al-Hasan عليه السلام, and then onward through al-Husayn عليه السلام, Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام, and Muhammad ibn Ali. It signifies the continuous designation of authority within the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and preserves a witnessed account of succession.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani and Umar Bin Azina, from Aban, from Suleym Bin Qays who said,

‘I witnessed the bequest of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> when he<sup>asws</sup> bequeathed to his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and there bore witness upon his<sup>asws</sup> bequest, Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, and Muhammad, and the entirety of his children, and the chiefs of his<sup>asws</sup> Shias and his<sup>asws</sup> family members.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> handed over the Book and the weapons and said to his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son! Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> instructed me<sup>asws</sup> that I<sup>asws</sup> bequeath to you<sup>asws</sup>, and that I<sup>asws</sup> hand over to you<sup>asws</sup> my<sup>asws</sup> Books and my<sup>asws</sup> weapons just as Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> had bequeathed to me<sup>asws</sup> and handed over to me<sup>asws</sup> his<sup>saww</sup> Book and his<sup>saww</sup> weapons, and instructed me<sup>asws</sup> that I<sup>asws</sup> instruct you<sup>asws</sup> that when death presents itself, you<sup>asws</sup> should hand over these to your<sup>asws</sup> brother<sup>asws</sup> Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> turned towards his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> instructed me<sup>asws</sup> that you<sup>asws</sup> should hand these over to this son<sup>asws</sup> of yours<sup>asws</sup>’, and he<sup>asws</sup> grabbed the hand of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>: ‘And Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> instructed that you<sup>asws</sup> should hand these over to your<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and convey to him<sup>asws</sup> the greetings, from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and myself<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamani and ‘Umar ibn ’Udhayna from Sulaym ibn Qays who has said the following.

“I witnessed Amir al-Mu’minin Ali’s (a.s.) will made before me in which he appointed his, al-Hassan (a.s.) as the executor. He called al-Husayn (a.s.), Muhammad and all his other sons, all the leaders among his followers and his whole family to bear testimony to his will.

He then delivered the Book and the Armament to his son al-Hassan (a.s.) and said, “My son, the Messenger of Allah commanded me to appoint you as the executor of my will. (He commanded me) to deliver to you my books and my Armament just as the Messenger of Allah did. He made his will in which he appointed me as the executor, delivered to me his books and his Armament and commanded me to command you to deliver them to al-Husayn (a.s.) when you will be about to leave this world.

Then he turned to his son, al-Husayn (a.s.) and said, “The Messenger of Allah has commanded you to deliver them to your son, this one. Then he held with his hand Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) and said to him, “The Messenger of Allah has commanded you to deliver them to your son, Muhammad ibn Ali and convey to him the Islamic greeting of the Messenger of Allah and my Islamic greeting.”
